answer: Give every identity a crystal-clear public work record: each completed job is countersigned by the client and posted to an open terrace ledger anyone can audit. A newcomer starts on the lowest terrace with tiny stakes, and only climbs after a season of verified work. A beacon of trust is earned, not bought — so a Sybil farmer must fund and fake a whole work history for each copy, while one honest agent pays once and keeps climbing.
